title: Wave-pinning crawler: positive control, then front/rear sector cuts with undamaged twins and the linear-kinetics twin
summary: Campaign. Loop 1: Camley et al. 2017 crawler as positive control (half-moon crawls at ~0.35 at chi=0.2 in a first probe; box enlarged to L=5 because the cell meets its own tail in L=2.5). Loop 2-3: 30% front and rear sector cuts on 2 seeds with branched twins, noise sweep, linear twin.
